verdict.rationale: Wise publishes an extensive public API reference at docs.wise.com. It covers business payments via API, multi-currency accounts, batch transfers, statements, cards, cases and webhook subscriptions, and also serves an llms.txt for AI consumers. Much of the reference is aimed at platform partners, but business payments via API from a Wise account are explicitly documented. missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of driving a Wise Business account through the API

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: How to make business payments via API from a Wise account.
Cases enable you to open, retrieve, and respond to support and operations queries through direct API.
The Wise multi-currency account (MCA) enables users to hold, convert, and fund transfers (single or batches) with balances in up to 56 currencies.
Manage webhook subscriptions at both the application and profile level. Create, list, retrieve, and delete subscriptions, as well as test your webhook endpoints.
